(TSXV:AUXX) (OTCQB:GSHRF) (FSE:DF80) (“Gold X2” or the “Company“) announces that its common shares (“Common Shares“) have been approved for listing on the NYSE American LLC (the “NYSE American“).The Common Shares are e…

The Common Shares are expected to begin trading on the NYSE American under symbol “AUXX” on September 8, 2026 or as soon thereafter as is permissible pursuant to applicable exchange rules and securities laws. Current shareholders of the Company do not need to take any action prior to the Company’s expected listing on the NYSE American. Concurrent with the start of trading on the NYSE American, the Common Shares will cease trading on the OTCQB. The Common Shares will continue trading on the TSX Venture Exchange (“
“Listing on the NYSE American represents an important milestone for Gold X2 as we continue to broaden our investor base and increase the Company’s visibility in the U.S. capital markets,”
said Michael Henrichsen, CEO and Director of Gold X2.

“Access to the world’s largest and most liquid equity market is expected to significantly enhance our exposure to U.S. institutional and retail investors while providing a stronger platform to unlock the value of the Moss Gold Project. The Moss Deposit is located in Ontario, Canada, one of the world’s premier mining jurisdictions, and benefits from exceptional existing infrastructure, including the Trans-Canada Highway and high-voltage power transmission lines within 12 kilometers of the deposit.”
The Company also announces that the British Columbia Registrar of Companies and the TSXV have granted the Company an extension to hold its annual general meeting of shareholders for 2026 (the “
“), which it was originally required to hold by September 26, 2026. The Company is now required to hold the AGM by January 26, 2027.

Gold X2 is a growth-oriented gold company focused on delivering long-term shareholder and stakeholder value through the acquisition and advancement of primary gold assets in tier-one jurisdictions. The Company’s current focus is the advanced stage 100% owned Moss Gold Project which is positioned in Ontario, Canada, with direct access from the Trans-Canada Highway, hydroelectric power near site, supportive local communities and skilled workforce. The 2026 updated National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects (“

“) for the Moss and East Coldstream Deposits has expanded to 2.458 million ounces of Indicated gold resources at 1.04 g/t Au, contained within 73.8 million tonnes and 4.209 million ounces of Inferred gold resources at 0.97 g/t Au contained within 134.7 million tonnes. The Moss Deposit also has a silver MRE of 3.160 million ounces of indicated silver resources at 1.53 g/t Ag contained within 64.3 Mt and 6.273 million ounces of inferred silver resources at 1.55 g/t Ag contained within 125.9 Mt. Results of a preliminary economic assessment (“

“) of the Moss Gold Project suggest the potential for the deposit to support a long-life mining operation with a strong production profile and low production costs. The MRE and PEA are supported by a NI 43-101 technical report for the Moss Gold Project available on the Company’s website and under the Company’s issuer profile on SEDAR+. For more information, please visit SEDAR+ (www.sedarplus.ca) and the Company’s website (www.goldx2.com).

Peter Flindell, PGeo, MAusIMM, MAIG, Chief Operating Officer, of the Company, and a qualified person under NI 43-101, has approved the scientific and technical information contained in this news release.
President, Chief Executive Officer and Director
